formula_checks.name: inverseOf
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Direction flipping plus kind switching is clear for explicit in/out records, but legacy signed-negative records without direction can be reversed twice depending on whether amount or kind owns its sign.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Normalize to explicit signed cash once, then generate the opposite; preserve exact snapshots when available.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: A record with no direction keeps its stored sign and is read by its kind’s way (moneyIntoAccount); its undo is the opposite kind with the same stored amount, so it moves the money back once. A transfer swaps its accounts and keeps its direction (DEC-6993).

formula_checks.name: cashEffect
formula_checks.reviewer_why: A missing amount returns 0 for a financial display even when its cash effect is unknown. Sale amount fallback also lacks a fee contract.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Return unknown effect for unentered amounts; keep confirmed zero distinct and define amount-only fee treatment.
formula_checks.records_or_app_fix: records fix: the rule text (0 is "no effect on the totals"; the missing amount is named at the door)
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: cashEffect gives 0 for an amount not on record; the account page’s door marks the same row noAmount (amountNotOnRecord) and shows a dash (DEC-6674). An amount-only sale comes only from bond, CD and other-investment sales, which record no fee; a fee on record is taken off where a sale’s proceeds are counted (tradesAfter, DEC-6873).
formula_checks.plain_example: Interest sent with no amount: the activity row shows a dash, not $0.

formula_checks.name: investmentIncomeAnnual
formula_checks.reviewer_why: The trailing window has a lower bound but no stated upper bound at as_of, allowing future-dated payouts. Missing amounts silently disappear from a purported total.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Use lower_bound ≤ date ≤ as_of, preserve signed reversals, and expose missing-amount coverage.
formula_checks.records_or_app_fix: records fix: the rule text (and drop the two unused imports, or bound the window at today and name missing amounts before anything calls it)
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: It counts cash payouts from a year before now with no end at today and drops a missing amount silently — and nothing calls it.
formula_checks.plain_example: A $1,000 payout dated tomorrow counts as this year’s income — on no screen.
